title: With so many amazing performances, it wa genuinely so hard for me to ...
transcript: here are my top five performances from the festival the three day musical theatre festival that just happened this past weekend in upstate New York at No. 5 I have Tyler Joseph Ellis and Andrew Barth Feldman's rendition of Hey Little Songbird from Hadestown it was just so unexpected I had no idea either of their voices could do this absolute perfection at number 4 I have Jenn Colella’s performance of Always Starting over she was the second cover for Idina on Broadway only went on once it has become one of these legendary understudy stories and I have always so regretted that I wasn't there to see it and now thanks to the festival I got to see it at No.3 I have Norbert Leo butz singing if I didn't believe in you from the last five years I mean he's the blueprint and I never thought that I would get to hear him sing this song absolutely unreal at number 2 I have of course Audra and Stokes singing wheels of a dream I will literally never get tired of hearing these two sing the song it is transcendent every single time and number 1 I'm cheating a little bit but it's the rent reunion technically it was like seven or eight performances but I can't pick one and getting to see this cast reunited singing these songs it is an experience I will never forget
classificationReason: Creator lists top 5 performances from a multi-show musical theatre festival, covering at least five different shows (Hadestown, The Last Five Years, Rent, Ragtime, If/Then). No single production is the focus, making this a roundup.
